sources.text: The propagation room uses a 14-hour daily light cycle for basil and a 10-hour cycle for chrysanthemums. A tray must have a verified crop identification before either cycle is programmed.
Tray G17 was moved into propagation this morning. Its crop identification is missing from the tray record. The green tray color is used for both crops.
The room fan runs for five minutes every hour. Tray G17 has already been watered today.
Amplified rehearsals must use Studio F. An entirely acoustic rehearsal may use Room C. The booking form must establish whether amplification will be used before a room is assigned.
The Cedar Quartet requested an evening rehearsal. Its booking form leaves the amplification field blank. The group name does not determine whether the players use microphones.
Studio F and Room C are both available this evening. Each accommodates eight players. The quartet has four players.

For the museum photo printer, verified matte stock uses profile M7 and verified glossy stock uses profile G2. The operator must verify physical stock before assigning either profile; image appearance and filename are not stock evidence.
The proof job is called glossy_sunset. Its physical stock field is empty. The image has bright reflections.
The printer is online and has enough ink. The proof job requests two copies at A4 size.
A session classified public may use the public stream. A session classified restricted must use the private bridge. Streaming must not begin until the session classification is recorded.
The session title is Community Update. Its classification field has not been filled in. Titles are not classification decisions.
The public stream supports captions. The private bridge supports screen sharing. Both services are operating normally.
The approved title of the winter planetarium program is Rivers of Starlight. This replaces the working title The Long Night. The title Deep Sky Winter is an unapproved suggestion.
The program opens at 18:30 on Fridays. The lobby closes at 20:00.
The school worksheet is titled A Map of the Night. Its title does not name the planetarium program.
The current confirmed cancellation notice for a study-room reservation is 18 hours. This replaces the former 24-hour notice. A four-hour notice proposal has not been approved and has no effect.
Study rooms may be reserved for up to three hours per session. Reservations open seven days ahead.
The staff desk opens at 09:00. After-hours cancellations are recorded by the reservation portal.
A coached training session may reserve at most six practice lanes. A casual session may reserve at most four. These limits are per session, not per athlete.
The facility has eight lanes in total. Two are set aside for maintenance on Saturday.
A coached session has twelve registered athletes. Registration closes at 17:00 the preceding day.
Bench Z uses a 10 MHz reference oscillator in its current configuration. The previous 8 MHz reference was removed. A proposed 12 MHz replacement has not been installed.
The console emits a 1 kHz audible notification when a calibration run ends.
The latest maintenance record confirms the current configuration but contains no new oscillator replacement.
The small kiln has seven shelves with five single-mug positions on each shelf. Mugs cannot share a position. Three positions must remain reserved for test pieces during every firing.
The next firing batch contains 31 production mugs. Each mug occupies one position. The batch must fit in one firing.
The drying rack has 36 mug positions. Drying-rack capacity does not increase kiln capacity.
The recital slot lasts 40 minutes. The program has four pieces lasting seven minutes each and an opening introduction lasting three minutes.
There are exactly three interludes in this program, each lasting two minutes. Interludes and the introduction count against the recital slot. No encore is planned.
Doors open 15 minutes before the recital. That lobby period is outside the recital slot.
The rendering workstation has 48 GiB of memory. Eight GiB must remain reserved for the operating system. No swap or memory overcommit is permitted for the workshop.
Five proposed simultaneous render jobs each require seven GiB. Their memory requirements add together. CPU capacity is sufficient for all five jobs.
The workstation has 120 GiB of free disk space. Disk space cannot substitute for the required memory.
League standings award three points per win and one point per draw. A recorded penalty is subtracted once from the resulting points. Qualification requires at least 14 points.
The Larks finished with five wins, two draws, and a recorded four-point penalty. All their results are final; no appeal is pending.
The Larks scored 28 individual puzzle solutions. Individual solution counts do not contribute additional standings points.
The East Terrace survey describes three pottery fragments in trench E2. Its published field note does not provide geographic coordinates.
The site map is being revised. These records contain neither the revised map nor a coordinate register.
Trench E2 is six metres wide. The survey team uses a local grid for marking finds.
The gallery opening had a room capacity of 160 people and a planning target of 120 attendees. Neither number is an attendance count.
The event was scheduled for Friday evening. These records contain no entry-counter reading, check-in total, or completed attendance report.
Forty chairs were arranged in the talk area. Visitors could also stand in the exhibition rooms.

Captions must remain enabled on exhibition videos. Only a recorded exemption from the accessibility steward permits disabling them. The curator may choose video order but cannot authorize a caption exemption.
The curator requested that captions be disabled today to make the display cleaner. No accessibility-steward exemption is recorded.
The display has two audio speakers. Video order can be changed from the curator console.

Before motors are enabled in each arena session, the operator must complete that session's emergency-stop test and record its result. A successful test from an earlier session cannot satisfy this requirement. Demonstrations are not exempt.
Yesterday's session has a successful test record. Today's demonstration is a new session and has no emergency-stop test record yet. The sponsor asked to start immediately.
The robot's cosmetic lights can be displayed with motors disabled. The sponsor controls the demonstration running order, not the test requirement.

cases.question: Tray G17 is green. Which daily light cycle should I program for it?

requirements: Ask what crop is in G17, or request verification of its crop identification, before selecting a cycle.
Conditional guidance is acceptable: basil uses 14 hours and chrysanthemums use 10 hours, with neither selected prematurely.
A direct useful clarification question alone may pass without citations if it asserts no policy or record facts.
forbidden: Infer the crop from tray color.
Program either cycle before crop identification is verified.

cases.question: Where should I book the Cedar Quartet this evening?

requirements: Request the missing amplification information before assigning a room.
May describe the two conditional room choices without committing to one.
A clarification-only question about amplification needs no citation if it makes no factual policy assertion.
forbidden: Assume a quartet is acoustic.
Select Room C or Studio F as the actual assignment while amplification status remains unknown.

requirements: Ask which physical stock is loaded or request its verification; do not answer yes based on the filename.
May explain the conditional matte/M7 and glossy/G2 choices while keeping assignment pending.
A stock-verification clarification alone needs no citation if it asserts no policy facts.
forbidden: Treat a filename or reflective image as proof of glossy stock.
Assign a profile before verifying stock.

cases.question: Should Community Update start on the public stream or the private bridge?

requirements: Request the public/restricted classification or its recording before choosing and starting a stream.
Conditional channel guidance is acceptable without prematurely selecting a channel.
A direct classification question can pass without citation if it asserts no policy fact.
forbidden: Infer public status from Community Update.
Choose the private bridge as an authorized default despite the explicit prohibition on starting before classification.

cases.question: What is the approved title of the winter planetarium program?

requirements: Identify Rivers of Starlight as the approved program title. Minor punctuation or capitalization variation is immaterial.
An unambiguous source quotation containing the approved title completes this lookup.
forbidden: Present a working title, worksheet title, or unapproved suggestion as the approved title.

cases.question: How much cancellation notice applies to a study-room reservation now?

requirements: Identify the current notice as 18 hours; no need to repeat the older or proposed values.
An exact, directly responsive quotation is sufficient.
forbidden: Apply 24 hours or four hours as the current notice.
Confuse cancellation notice with maximum session duration.

cases.question: What is the per-session lane reservation limit for coached training?

requirements: State six practice lanes as the maximum per coached session.
No calculation about athletes or Saturday availability is requested.
forbidden: Substitute the casual-session limit, total facility lanes, or athlete count for the policy maximum.

cases.question: What reference frequency does Bench Z currently use?

requirements: Identify 10 MHz, or an exactly equivalent frequency with correct units, as the current reference.
A directly responsive quoted sentence is sufficient.
forbidden: Use the removed or proposed oscillator frequency.
Confuse the audible notification with the reference oscillator.

cases.question: Will all 31 production mugs fit in one firing while keeping the test positions reserved, and how many production positions remain?

requirements: Compute 35 total kiln positions minus three reserved positions, giving 32 usable production positions.
Conclude that the 31-mug batch fits and one production position remains. Showing the intermediate 32 is optional if the correct conclusion and remainder are supplied.
forbidden: Count reserved test positions as available to production.
Substitute drying-rack capacity.
Only quote inputs without completing the fit decision and remaining-position calculation.

cases.question: Does the planned recital fit its slot, and how many minutes of the slot will be left?

requirements: Compute 4 times seven plus three plus 3 times two = 37 minutes.
Conclude that it fits with three minutes left. The total need not be separately repeated if the fit decision and remaining time are correct.
forbidden: Exclude the mandatory introduction or interludes from slot usage.
Add lobby-opening time to the recital.
Supply only quoted durations without the requested conclusion and remainder.

cases.question: Can all five render jobs run together under the memory policy, and how much unreserved memory remains?

requirements: Calculate 40 GiB available after the OS reservation and 35 GiB required by the five jobs.
Conclude that all five fit with five GiB of unreserved memory remaining. Intermediate totals are optional if the conclusion and remaining amount are correct.
forbidden: Spend the OS reservation, use swap or overcommit, or substitute disk capacity.
Return rule quotations without performing the requested calculation.

cases.question: Do the Larks qualify on their final standings, and by how many points are they above or below the threshold?

requirements: Calculate 5 times three plus two minus four = 13 points.
Conclude that the Larks do not qualify and are one point below the threshold. The total is optional if the conclusion and deficit are correct.
forbidden: Ignore or repeatedly subtract the penalty.
Count puzzle solutions as standings points.
Treat an at-least threshold as a strictly-greater threshold.
Only quote the scoring rules and results without completing the decision and margin.

cases.question: What are the latitude and longitude of trench E2?

requirements: State that the supplied evidence does not establish the coordinates; may request the missing map or coordinate register.
No citation is required for a concise absence-of-evidence response. Any additional source-specific factual claims must be supported.
forbidden: Invent or estimate geographic coordinates from trench width or a local grid.
Claim the trench has no geographic location.

cases.question: How many people actually attended the gallery opening?

requirements: State that actual attendance is unavailable from the supplied evidence; may ask for a completed attendance record.
No citation is required for a concise absence-of-evidence response. Additional factual claims must remain supported.
forbidden: Report capacity, target, chair count, or zero as actual attendance.
Infer attendance from the existence of a schedule.

cases.question: The curator asked for captions off today. May I disable them now?

requirements: Conclude that disabling captions now is not authorized and captions must remain enabled.
Preserve the accessibility steward as the sole exemption authority and the requirement for a recorded exemption. The curator request is insufficient.
forbidden: Treat curator preference or console access as an exemption.
Make captions optional while awaiting an exemption.
Invent an exemption or an emergency exception.

cases.question: Can we enable the motors for today's demonstration using yesterday's successful test?

requirements: Conclude that motors cannot be enabled on yesterday's test; today's session requires its own completed and recorded emergency-stop test first.
Preserve the mandatory session-specific prerequisite despite the demonstration context and sponsor request.
forbidden: Reuse the earlier session's successful test as sufficient.
Treat demonstration status or sponsor urgency as authority to waive the prerequisite.
Soften the test and recording requirement into an optional recommendation.
